Slakoth

Normal

Hoenn · Generation 3

Slakoth is a Normal-type Slacker Pokémon first found in Hoenn (Generation 3). It stands 0.8 m tall and weighs 24 kg. It evolves into Vigoroth. Its highest base stat is HP (60), with a base stat total of 280.
